input.title: Stale cursor after indenting and clicking bullet to collapse
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
- b
  - c
```

1. Indent `b`
2. Click the bullet of `b`

## Current Behavior

The cursor is set to outdated Path `['b']`. 

## Expected Behavior

The cursor should be set to `a`.

Tapping an expanded cursor bullet should collapse the thought and move the cursor up a level.
